"""Python baseline for examples/expenses/expense.ax"""
from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Literal

from pydantic import BaseModel

from baselines.runtime import Runtime


class Classification(BaseModel):
    classification: Literal["business", "personal", "unclear"]


def main(rt: Runtime) -> list[dict]:
    """Process all pending expense claims and return status for each."""
    results = []

    # List all pending expenses
    expense_ids = rt.call("expenses.pending", "main#0")

    # Process each expense
    for idx, expense_id in enumerate(expense_ids):
        base_site = f"exp#{idx}"

        # Fetch the expense
        expense = rt.call("expenses.get", f"{base_site}#0", id=expense_id)

        # Look up the employee
        employee = rt.call("directory.lookup", f"{base_site}#1", email=expense["employee_email"])

        # Ask the model to classify the expense
        result = rt.ask("llm", f"{base_site}#2", Classification,
                       "Classify this expense note as a business expense or personal. Return exactly one of: business, personal, or unclear.",
                       context=expense["note"], retries=1)
        classification = result.classification

        # Process based on classification - use employee data immediately
        status = process_expense(rt, base_site, expense_id, expense, employee, classification)
        results.append({"expense_id": expense_id, "status": status})

    return results


def process_expense(rt: Runtime, base_site: str, expense_id: str, expense: dict, employee: dict, classification: str) -> str:
    """Process an expense and determine its status."""

    # Check if currency is not EUR or classification is unclear
    if expense["currency"] != "EUR" or classification == "unclear":
        rt.call("mail.send", f"{base_site}#3",
               to=employee["manager_email"],
               subject=f"Expense {expense_id} needs review",
               body="")
        return "needs review"

    # Check if classification is personal
    if classification == "personal":
        rt.call("mail.send", f"{base_site}#3",
               to=employee["email"],
               subject=f"Expense {expense_id} rejected",
               body="")
        return "rejected"

    # Check if amount exceeds reimbursement limit
    if expense["amount"] > employee["reimbursement_limit"]:
        rt.call("mail.send", f"{base_site}#3",
               to=employee["manager_email"],
               subject=f"Expense {expense_id} needs review",
               body="")
        return "needs review"

    # Reimburse the amount
    rt.call("payroll.reimburse", f"{base_site}#4",
           employee_id=employee["id"],
           amount=expense["amount"],
           expense_id=expense_id)
    return "reimbursed"

"""Python baseline for examples/expenses (expense reimbursement workflow)."""
from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Literal

from pydantic import BaseModel

from baselines.runtime import Runtime


class Classification(BaseModel):
    classification: Literal["business", "personal", "unclear"]


class Employee(BaseModel):
    id: str
    email: str
    manager_email: str
    reimbursement_limit: float


def main(rt: Runtime) -> list[dict]:
    results = []

    # Step 1: List pending expense ids
    expense_ids = rt.call("expenses.pending", "main#0")

    for i, expense_id in enumerate(expense_ids):
        # Step 2: Fetch the expense
        expense = rt.call("expenses.get", f"main#{i+1}", id=expense_id)

        # Step 3: Look up the employee in the directory
        employee_data = rt.call("directory.lookup", f"main#{i+2}", email=expense["employee_email"])
        employee = Employee(**employee_data)

        # Step 4: Ask the model to classify the expense
        classification = rt.ask(
            "llm",
            f"main#{i+3}",
            Classification,
            f"Classify this expense note as business, personal, or unclear. Return exactly one of: 'business', 'personal', 'unclear'.",
            context=expense["note"],
            retries=1
        )

        # Step 5: Decide per expense
        status = determine_status(rt, expense, employee, classification.classification, expense_id, i)

        results.append({
            "expense_id": expense_id,
            "status": status
        })

    return results


def determine_status(rt: Runtime, expense: dict, employee: Employee, classification: str, expense_id: str, index: int) -> str:
    """Determine the status and take appropriate actions for an expense."""

    # If currency is not EUR, or classification is "unclear": status "needs review"
    if expense["currency"] != "EUR" or classification == "unclear":
        rt.call("mail.send", f"iter{index}#4", to=employee.manager_email,
                subject=f"Expense {expense_id} needs review", body="")
        return "needs review"

    # If classification is "personal": status "rejected"
    if classification == "personal":
        rt.call("mail.send", f"iter{index}#5", to=employee.manager_email,
                subject=f"Expense {expense_id} rejected", body="")
        return "rejected"

    # If amount > employee's reimbursement_limit: status "needs review"
    if expense["amount"] > employee.reimbursement_limit:
        rt.call("mail.send", f"iter{index}#6", to=employee.manager_email,
                subject=f"Expense {expense_id} needs review", body="")
        return "needs review"

    # Otherwise: reimburse
    rt.call("payroll.reimburse", f"iter{index}#7", employee_id=employee.id,
            amount=expense["amount"], expense_id=expense_id)
    return "reimbursed"

"""Python baseline for examples/expenses/SPEC.md"""
from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Literal

from pydantic import BaseModel

from baselines.runtime import Runtime


class Classification(BaseModel):
    result: Literal["business", "personal", "unclear"]


def main(rt: Runtime) -> list[dict]:
    ids = rt.call("expenses.pending", "main#0")

    results = []
    site_num = 1

    for expense_id in ids:
        expense = rt.call("expenses.get", f"main#{site_num}", id=expense_id)
        site_num += 1

        employee = rt.call("directory.lookup", f"main#{site_num}", email=expense["employee_email"])
        site_num += 1

        c = rt.ask("llm", f"main#{site_num}", Classification,
                  "Classify this expense as business, personal, or unclear.",
                  context=expense["note"], retries=1)
        site_num += 1

        status = decide(rt, expense, employee, c.result, site_num)
        site_num += 1
        results.append({"expense_id": expense["id"], "status": status})

    return results


def decide(rt: Runtime, expense: dict, employee: dict, classification: str, site_num: int) -> str:
    if expense["currency"] != "EUR" or classification == "unclear":
        rt.call("mail.send", f"main#{site_num}",
               to=employee["manager_email"],
               subject=f"Expense {expense['id']} needs review",
               body="")
        return "needs review"

    if classification == "personal":
        rt.call("mail.send", f"main#{site_num}",
               to=employee["manager_email"],
               subject=f"Expense {expense['id']} rejected",
               body="")
        return "rejected"


    if expense["amount"] > employee["reimbursement_limit"]:
        rt.call("mail.send", f"main#{site_num}",
               to=employee["manager_email"],
               subject=f"Expense {expense['id']} needs review",
               body="")
        return "needs review"

    rt.call("payroll.reimburse", f"main#{site_num}",
           employee_id=employee["id"],
           amount=expense["amount"],
           expense_id=expense["id"])
    return "reimbursed"
